newsitem.title: SENEGAL: W.Africa Franc zone cuts discount rate to 6.50 pct.
newsitem.headline: W.Africa Franc zone cuts discount rate to 6.50 pct.

text.p: The West African Franc zone's Central Bank BCEAO has lowered its discount rate by half a point to 6.50 percent, the bank said in a statement.
The new rate took effect last Monday, it added. The rate applies to banks in seven member countries -- Benin, Burkina Faso, Ivory Coast, Mali, Niger, Senegal and Togo.
The statement said that the drop was in line with efforts to stimulate investment and production in member countries, in order to strengthen economic and financial recovery.
The bank's intervention rate was not adjusted and remains at 6.00 percent.
